🚀 Advanced Feature

Synchronize device sensors (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer) with GPS movement.

✅ Benefits:
• Makes movement appear real to the app
• Bypasses machine learning detection of inconsistent sensors
• Uses Kalman filtering for smooth motion

⚠️ Note:
• May affect apps that rely on real sensors
• Slightly increases CPU usage

Recommended for: High-end detection bypass

🚀 Advanced Feature

Simulate base station and WiFi data to match your virtual GPS location.

✅ Benefits:
• App cannot detect location anomalies through network comparison
• Generates real WiFi AP names and signal strength
• Simulates base station ID and location area code (LAC)

⚠️ Note:
• May affect apps that rely on real network information
• Does not affect actual internet connection

Recommended for: Apps that verify location through network triangulation

🚀 Advanced Features

Adds real variations to GPS data, time, and movement mode.

✅ Benefits:
• Prevents device fingerprinting
• Bypasses machine learning models that analyze movement patterns
• Uses Brownian motion to generate natural position jitter
• Smooth acceleration/deceleration buffering

⚠️ Note:
• May cause slight GPS position deviation
• Very lightweight - has minimal impact on performance

Recommended for: Highest stealth level for advanced detection
